runtime.multi_board_smoke: Separate runtime per reserved board, selected by PCI BDF in TT_VISIBLE_DEVICES; each chip trains independently.

limitations: Training is a synthetic TTNN linear-regression test with explicit analytic gradients, not arbitrary-model autograd or distributed training.
DRA board-count requests do not guarantee a connected fabric topology for multi-board models.
Mist API integration still needs to create Kubernetes Jobs and device claims.
Host runtime directories and hugepage filesystems remain shared; this is not a full untrusted-tenant security boundary.
Vendor ResourceSlice memory capacity is incorrect (281453674972256 bytes per n300); claims intentionally do not use memory-capacity placement.
